'''J's Salamence''' (Japanese: '''Jのボーマンダ''' ''J's Bohmander'') is one of the Pokémon owned by [[J|Pokémon Hunter J]], as well as her most used. 

==History==
[[File:J Salamence debut.png|thumb|left|220px|Salamence in its debut]]
Salamence debuted in ''[[DP020|Mutiny in the Bounty!]]'', the same episode as its {{pkmn|Trainer}}. It mostly serves as J's mode of transportation while she is not in her airship. It is also frequently used in battle.

In ''[[DP045|Ill-Will Hunting!]]'', J used Salamence and her {{p|Drapion}} to battle [[Ash's Pikachu]] and [[Gary's Blastoise]].

J tends to use Salamence for destructive purposes as well. In ''[[DP071|Pokémon Ranger and the Kidnapped Riolu! (Part 1)]]'', she commanded it to destroy a forest with its {{m|Flamethrower}} to smoke out the {{p|Riolu}} she wanted to capture.

Later, in ''[[DP129|Pillars of Friendship!]]'', J used its {{m|Hyper Beam}} to knock down the rock, ice, and steel pillars inside the [[Snowpoint Temple]] and Flamethrower to awaken {{p|Regigigas}}. Salamence is also able to hold its own in battle against [[legendary Pokémon]] such as Regigigas and also could evade a volley of {{m|Hyper Beam}}s from {{an|Brandon}}'s [[Brandon's legendary giants|Regirock, Registeel, and Regice]] with ease.

In ''[[DP151|The Needs of the Three!]]'', it was used by J to get {{DL|Lake guardians (anime)|Uxie}}, {{DL|Lake guardians (anime)|Mesprit}}, and {{DL|Lake guardians (anime)|Azelf}} for [[Team Galactic]]. What happened to Salamence after the destruction of J's ship is unknown.

In ''[[DP191|Memories are Made of Bliss!]]'', {{TRT}}'s fantasy featured Salamence with J riding it.

==Personality and characteristics==
[[File:J and Salamence.png|thumb|250px|Salamence and J]]
Salamence exhibited little real personality in its various appearances other than being extremely loyal to J, as show in ''[[DP071|Pokémon Ranger and the Kidnapped Riolu! Part One]]'' when it was commanded by J to use {{m|Flamethrower}} on a forest just so J could capture a {{p|Riolu}} for profit. In many of the battles Salamence partook in, it barely took damage from its opponents' attacks and had quick movements that allowed it to not get hit by them as well. Similar to {{an|Giovanni}} with his {{TP|Giovanni|Persian}}, J appears to value Salamence more than her other Pokémon, and it was used more often by her.
